status: Discrete foot/digit/shin topology and strict-crossing screen; not complete motion or physics acceptance
method: Existing strict edge-through-face kernel, 1e-7m plane and 1e-6 barycentric/edge margins. One actual witness per identity, no pair exemptions. Includes same-owner distinct meshes separately. Each model uses its own fresh actual-GLB matrices.
limits: Three discrete states only; no swept/continuous collision, physics, containment, tangent/coplanar or within-mesh selfintersection claim.
Adjacent scope is meshes descended from feet/digits and shin owners; torso/thigh and procedural era hardware excluded.
Pair counts are identities, not penetration depth or independent defect counts.
